 Order

In terms of an order dated 10.04.2023, this Court in a very categoric terms called upon the Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch to undertake exercise for land acquisition with respect to the land of the petitioners which otherwise had come to be appropriated for the purpose of construction of a road without any land acquisition exercise way back in the year 2009-2010.

2. In view of this, this writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the Collector Land Acquisition concerned to proceed ahead with the land acquisition exercise under the Act of 2013 with due dispatch and complete the land acquisition proceedings within the time stipulated under the Act of 2013.

5. In case the writ petitioners would ever feel aggrieved that the land acquisition exercise which has been set into effect is not heading towards conclusion and is suffering delay, the petitioners shall be well within their rights to approach this Court with a writ petition.

6. It is further directed that an amount of Rs. 8,12,000/- which was deposited by the Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch with this Court shall be remitted back along with interest accrued, if any, to the Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch so that in the event of full compensation computed for payment to the petitioners,
this amount also gets available with the Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch for the purpose of payment.

7. Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch is directed to keep the aforesaid amount of Rs. 8,12,000/- in a fixed deposit that shall coincide with the passing of the award by the Collector Land Acquisition concerned.

opennyai_summary.decision:
In terms of an order dated 10.04.2023, this Court in a very categoric terms called upon the Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch to undertake exercise for land acquisition with respect to the land of the petitioners which otherwise had come to be appropriated for the purpose of construction of a road without any land acquisition exercise way back in the year 2009-2010.
3. In view of the fact that the land acquisition exercise has been set into effect which is now supposed to result in passing of the award under Right to Fair Compensation, Transparency and Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short 'Act of 2013'), the actual purpose of the writ petition gets met.
4. In view of this, this writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the Collector Land Acquisition concerned to proceed ahead with the land acquisition exercise under the Act of 2013 with due dispatch and complete the land acquisition proceedings within the time stipulated under the Act of 2013.
5. In case the writ petitioners would ever feel aggrieved that the land acquisition exercise which has been set into effect is not heading towards conclusion and is suffering delay, the petitioners shall be well within their rights to approach this Court with a writ petition.
6. It is further directed that an amount of Rs. 8,12,000/- which was deposited by the Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch with this Court shall be remitted back along with interest accrued, if any, to the Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch so that in the event of full compensation computed for payment to the petitioners,
this amount also gets available with the Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch for the purpose of payment.
7. Executive Engineer, Public Works (R&B) Department Division Poonch is directed to keep the aforesaid amount of Rs. 8,12,000/- in a fixed deposit that shall coincide with the passing of the award by the Collector Land Acquisition concerned.
